intro: Varimathras is a dreadlord of the nathrezim race who serves as the chief lieutenant and military advisor to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Forced to pledge loyalty to the Banshee Queen after suffering defeat during the civil war for Lordaeron, he now stands at her right hand in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity.

p: Before the Third War, Kil'jaeden sent Varimathras and his fellow dreadlords to Azeroth as the Lich King's jailors, to make sure the spirit of Ner'zhul served the Legion's plans. Bound alongside his brothers Detheroc and Balnazzar, he oversaw the Scourge in Lordaeron while Archimonde invaded Kalimdor. When the Legion fell at Mount Hyjal, the triumvirate remained entrenched in the ruins of the Capital City, entirely unaware of their master's demise until Prince Arthas returned to drive them into hiding.

As the Lich King's hold over his undead forces fractured, Varimathras attempted to coerce the newly freed banshee Sylvanas Windrunner into serving the dreadlords' new regime. Sylvanas refused, rallying liberated undead to crush Varimathras's outpost. Facing execution, the dreadlord fell to his knees and bartered for his life, trading tactical secrets and knowledge of his brothers' fortifications in exchange for survival. Sylvanas accepted, binding him to her service as a living weapon against his kin.
